# PrivacyWatch API v1 — Plan

**Status:** implemented in v1.13.0. Change from the draft: `/providers/{id}` and `/meta` are small Pages Functions reading the deployed `providers.json` (via the ASSETS binding) instead of build-generated files — less build code, same data.

**Goal:** a public, read-only API over the structured dataset (96/96 rows with
evidence) for developers, compliance reviewers and AI agents.

**Constraint:** simple. Same stack as today (Cloudflare Pages + Pages
Functions, plain Node ESM, `node --test`). No database for this — the whole
dataset is ~450 KB of JSON and ships with every deploy.

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | How | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/providers` | Pages Function (filters in memory) | Summary rows matching filters |
| `GET /api/v1/providers/{id}` | Static JSON, generated at build | One full row incl. `evidence[]`, `incidents[]` |
| `GET /api/v1/meta` | Static JSON | version, lastUpdated, counts, vocabularies, licence |
| `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` | Static JSON | OpenAPI 3.1 spec |
| `GET /api/search?q=` | Existing function | Semantic search over policy text (unchanged) |
| `GET /providers.json` | Existing static file | Full dataset (unchanged, kept for compatibility) |

### Filters on `/api/v1/providers`

All optional, combined with AND; repeat a param or comma-separate for OR.

- `category` — us-frontier, chinese, inference, coding
- `rating` — clean, guarded, caution, high-risk, unverified
- `surfaceType` — api, consumer
- `training` — `training.default` values (off, on, opt-in, …)
- `zdr` — `zdr.access` values (default, self-serve, …)
- `retention` — `retention.kind` values; `maxRetentionDays=N` (fixed-only, ≤ N)
- `region` — ISO code / EU / GLOBAL (row has it in `location.regions`)
- `incident` — true/false
- `ids` — comma list (this is "compare": fetch several rows side by side)
- `fields=full` — return full rows instead of summaries

Summary row: `id, name, surface, category, rating, incident, training.default,
retention.kind/days, zdr.access, location.regions, sourceDate, url` (link to the
full row). Response wrapper: `{ meta: {version, lastUpdated, count}, data: [...] }`.
Unknown filter values → 400 with the allowed list (from `VOCAB`).

## Implementation

1. `scripts/lib/api.mjs` — pure functions: `summarize(row)`, `filterProviders(rows, params)` → tested with `node --test` (filters, OR/AND, 400 cases, `maxRetentionDays`, silent vs missing).
2. `functions/api/v1/providers.js` — imports `providers.json`, calls the lib, sets headers.
3. `scripts/build.mjs` — also writes `dist/api/v1/providers/{id}.json`, `meta.json`, and `openapi.json` (hand-written spec in `api/openapi.json`, version injected at build).
4. `_headers` — `/api/v1/*`: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600`, JSON content type.
5. Short docs section in README ("API"), plus a small `/api` page linking the spec. No SDK.

Estimated size: ~300 lines incl. tests. One PR.

## Deliberately not in v1

- API keys, accounts, rate-limit tiers, billing. Cloudflare's default edge protection is enough for a cached read-only API. Add keys only when a paid tier exists.
- `/api/ask` (LLM answers) — stays gated on the existing benchmark plan.
- Change history endpoint — later, derived from git/CHANGELOG.
- Per-provider brief pages — next phase, built on the same `api.mjs` summaries.

## Decisions needed

1. ~~Data licence~~ — decided: CC BY 4.0 for data, MIT for code (v1.13.0).
2. ~~Versioning promise~~ — decided: within `/api/v1`, fields are added freely; removing or renaming a field, or changing what a value means, is announced in the CHANGELOG at least 30 days ahead and the old field keeps working during that notice period. Large or incompatible changes ship under `/api/v2`. Documented in `docs/API.md` and on `/api-docs`.
